name: voxel-bellandur
description: A single self-contained HTML file that renders **3.3 × 2.9 km of Bellandur — Bellandur Lake and the Bellandur stretch of the Outer Ring Road** — as an instanced voxel model. Every road, footprint, water body and place name in the scene comes from an OpenStreetMap extract; nothing is placed from memory. Open `voxel-bellandur.html` and it runs offline, with no network requests, no textures, no external models and no fonts to download.
